title: Class and unit group oracle corpus
objective: Build deterministic Sage/PARI, Magma, and optional Hecke oracle corpus and benchmark harness for class groups, units, regulators, maps, and proof modes

handoff.summary: Added a network-free 16-field corpus and persistent Sage/PARI plus Magma harness covering degrees 1 through 5, every quartic signature, discriminants, cyclic and repeated-factor class groups, unit ranks 0 through 4, torsion, 100/200-bit Arb regulator intervals, oracle-specific generator ideals, exact ideal class logs, principality witnesses, conditional-GRH and unconditional labels, invalid inputs, alternate and nonmonogenic presentations, a large-unit stress field, and the motivating discriminant-12 quadratic and discriminant-380452 C4 quintic. The pinned normalized baseline retains exact output and one-sample timings; the all-tier self-check reports exact structural agreement across both independent implementation families. A metadata-only pure quintic x^5-1009 records the 231-fold factor-base-bound gap and bounded unconditional failure evidence. README and fixture record directional Sage.js acceptance thresholds.
risks: Julia is not installed on the capture host, so Hecke/Oscar is explicitly unavailable and is not counted as a third agreeing implementation family; exact upstream versions and commits are pinned for a future adapter.
Magma 2.18-5 Cputime is coarse and its retained one-sample timings are historical context, not gates.

The first broad native validation was terminated by the shared host during a clean build; a retry was stopped at the coordinator's request once focused self-checks passed. The initial architecture check also encountered the absent clean-worktree dist/tools/cli before that build. This lane changes only benchmark, fixture, and task-contract files.
The x^5-1009 unconditional Magma computation is metadata-only after an intentional 60-second interruption and is excluded from ordinary tiers.
next_steps: Consume the normalized class, map, unit, and regulator projections in the class/unit implementation lanes and enforce the recorded proof labels as distinct cache states.
Add a Hecke/Oscar adapter only on a host with a pinned Julia environment, then review exact generator-basis changes rather than weakening the two-family checks.
Run pnpm test:native and architecture:check in the integration lane after its normal build artifacts are available.
Ratchet the directional warm thresholds only from uncontended five-sample Sage.js implementation measurements.
